title: 鐵路道岔轉轍機
summary: 本課聚焦轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈。從轉轍力位移作功建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把馬達回路與接觸與鎖閉確認狀態機連成可驗證的介面，最後以轉轍維修服務影響整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain. Start with point-machine force–travel work to define physical or information boundaries, connect motor circuit and contact behaviour with state machine for lock confirmation as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through service impact of point maintenance. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 轉轍力位移作功與連桿幾何與力矩
stages.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work & Linkage geometry and torque
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉轍力位移作功」與「連桿幾何與力矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Point-machine force–travel work" and "Linkage geometry and torque": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉轍力位移作功」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Point-machine force–travel work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉轍力位移作功」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Point-machine force–travel work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉轍力位移作功」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Point-machine force–travel work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉轍力位移作功
knowledge.text: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。
knowledge.textEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉轍力位移作功」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Point-machine force–travel work" is correct?
options: 致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉
本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。
力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩
optionsEn: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak.
A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉轍力位移作功」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Point-machine force–travel work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。

Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉轍力位移作功」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Point-machine force–travel work", which statement holds?
options: 只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉轍力位移作功」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Point-machine force–travel work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「轉轍力位移作功」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For point-machine force–travel work, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把作用力 F 從 4500 改成 4950 N（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 830.769 變為 913.846 J。先說明「轉轍力位移作功」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only applied force F from 4500 to 4950 N (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 830.769 to 913.846 J. Explain the causal direction for point-machine force–travel work, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For point-machine force–travel work, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉轍力位移作功」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Point-machine force–travel work"?
options: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。

optionsEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉轍力位移作功」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Point-machine force–travel work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「轉轍力位移作功」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for point-machine force–travel work. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「轉轍力位移作功」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for point-machine force–travel work. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉轍力位移作功」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Point-machine force–travel work" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。
力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking.
A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「連桿幾何與力矩」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Linkage geometry and torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。力矩取決於力與轉軸的垂直力臂，不只取決於馬達功率。連桿角度改變會改變機械利益，接近死點時力與位移關係尤其敏感；外殼上的扭矩讀值也不一定等於尖軌端的實際推力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「連桿幾何與力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. Torque depends on force and perpendicular lever arm, not merely motor power. Linkage angle changes mechanical advantage, particularly near a dead centre where force-displacement relations become sensitive. Torque measured at the housing need not equal effective force at the switch blade. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Linkage geometry and torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Linkage geometry and torque”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 連桿幾何與力矩
knowledge.text: 本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。力矩取決於力與轉軸的垂直力臂，不只取決於馬達功率。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. Torque depends on force and perpendicular lever arm, not merely motor power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連桿幾何與力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Linkage geometry and torque" is correct?
options: 力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩
兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零
本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。
optionsEn: A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes.
quiz.explanation: 本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連桿幾何與力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Linkage geometry and torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「連桿幾何與力矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Linkage geometry and torque", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。
外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連桿幾何與力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Linkage geometry and torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。以「連桿幾何與力矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. For linkage geometry and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「連桿幾何與力矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for linkage geometry and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。以「連桿幾何與力矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. For linkage geometry and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「連桿幾何與力矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for linkage geometry and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「連桿幾何與力矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Linkage geometry and torque"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「連桿幾何與力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Linkage geometry and torque” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。回到「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Trace the input chain for linkage geometry and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。回到「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Trace the input chain for linkage geometry and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「連桿幾何與力矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Linkage geometry and torque" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零
把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel.
quiz.explanation: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
